option_B_mechanism.explanation: Fairlearn's equalized-odds post-processing (Hardt et al., 2016) picks one operating point (common false-positive rate x_best, true-positive rate y_best) that every group can reach: the best point on the LOWEST of the groups' ROC curves. Groups whose ROC curve lies above that point are pulled down to it by mixing their own threshold rule with the ROC diagonal: with probability p_ignore the score is ignored and the appointment is flagged with probability x_best. That product is a flag probability that is the same for every appointment in the group, whatever its score. The group with the lowest curve (here: senior) needs no mixing (p_ignore = 0).
